entities.name: Kamat
entities.description: A Naga warrior of Naktamun on Amonkhet and an initiate of the Tah crop who died in the Trial of Ambition.

entities.name: Tah crop
entities.description: The initiate crop Kamat belonged to.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God who oversaw the last chamber.

entities.name: Neit
entities.description: Crop member who claimed Kamat's heart.

events.summary: Kamat embarked upon the Trial of Ambition, reached the last chamber overseen by Bontu, and did not survive the last culling; Neit claimed her heart.
events.quote: she did not survive the last culling

relations.note: She was an initiate of the crop.
